title: Make the trainer console connector + tunnel survive a reboot (persistent systemd units)
note: Found by lane UI-CONSOLE-V1 2026-11-05: jta-console-connector (127.0.0.1:8765) and jta-mcp-tunnel run as TRANSIENT systemd-run units on ict-trainer-vm (#23224/#23254), so a trainer reboot or OOM kill takes the console's data path down with no restart. Caddy (systemd-enabled, #23262) does survive. Fix: commit deploy/trainer/jta-console-connector.service (Restart=always, Nice=10, MemoryMax=400M, EnvironmentFile for CONSOLE_CONNECTOR_AUTH/BASE_URL/GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/ALLOWED_EMAIL) and install+enable it via a trainer workflow; retire jta-mcp-tunnel once 'JTA Trader' (sslip.io) replaces 'JTA Console Probe'. Closing observation: after 'sudo systemctl restart' of the trainer (or kill -9 of the process), https://158-178-209-121.sslip.io/healthz returns 200 within 60 s without manual action.  2026-11-05 14:10Z lane: FINDINGS (trainer diag #23338): running process started 12:21Z, before #23296 (checkout already at 9d1c9ccb) => 4 tools; env had no DIAG_READ_TOKEN and no TRADE_JOURNAL_DB; /etc/ict-trader absent; token store runtime_logs/console_connector_oauth.json is file-backed (0600, atomic write, written 13:04Z), not under /run, so it survives restart. Repo-root trade_journal.db on trainer is stale (Oct 25); the synced snapshot dest is data/trade_journal.db. Unit deploy/trainer/jta-console-connector.service + workflow trainer-console-connector-install (landing hold).
